answer: Each identity is assigned, each epoch, one random established identity to serve as its raven, and it must carry a small ember of work — a fresh, verifiable task — to that raven, who must acknowledge receiving it. A zephyr of trust grows only from these acknowledgments, and each established identity can acknowledge only a few deliveries per epoch, so a farm of a thousand fakes needs a thousand acknowledgments the network cannot supply at once. Each fake must convince a stranger chosen by the network, not a friend it picked, while one honest identity carries one ember to one raven.
